Input: {"question": "What is \"The Great McGonagall\" known for?", "segments": [{"id": "s0", "text": "Great McGonagall\" was the seventh in a string of flops for Sellers, whose career improved with his next film, \"The Return of the Pink Panther\" (1975)."}, {"id": "s1", "text": "In \"The New York Times\", Richard Eder wrote, \"'The Great McGonagall,' which opened yesterday at the Cinema Village, is endearing, and parts of it are lovely and hilarious."}, {"id": "s2", "text": "But it lacks enough of an organizing principle in its chaos to succeed as a movie...The pace is frenetic, the level of reality shifts every two minutes, it is stuffed with visual absurdities, old jokes and take-offs."}, {"id": "s3", "text": "Some work, some exasperate...McGonagall dies, and you are sorry."}]}
